card.name: Word right before an equals sign
card.fires_on: The last piece of a short key or abbreviation just before an '=' sign, in URL query strings (watch?v=, p2=) and in abbreviation lists like 'TEN=toxic epidermal necrolysis'.

modes.label: URL query keys
modes.description: The key in a web address query string, right before '=' and its value.

modes.label: Abbreviation definitions
modes.description: The final letters of an abbreviation in a list of 'ABBR=meaning' entries.
modes.example: SJS=Stevens Johnson syndrome,<< TEN>>=toxic epidermal necro

card.writes: It promotes short single-letter value starts after '=' and suppresses quote- or bracket-plus-equals forms used in code.
card.plain: It fires on a short label just before an equals sign, as in web links or abbreviation keys.
